description: Get notified the moment the user gets paid. Register an https URL that Swop will POST a signed JSON event to when the linked account gets paid (checkout.paid) and paid out (payout.released). Returns a signing secret ONCE — tell the user to store it now; it cannot be retrieved again. Deliveries carry a Swop-Signature header: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret>; failed deliveries retry for about 15 hours. Confirm the exact URL with the user first.

events.description: Which events to send. Default: both

url.description: https URL to POST events to (http allowed for localhost only)
